### ST-099

**npm publishing with provenance and changesets**

*As a **release manager**, I want **automated, signed releases with changelogs**, so that **users can verify what they install**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 3 | S10 | §30.6 | [ST-006](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-006), [ST-011](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-011) |

**Status:** partial — Self-contained bundle and `pnpm release:publish` (local) are ready. npm provenance dropped: it requires hosted CI. First publish waits for the name decision.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Changesets drive versions and CHANGELOG
- [ ] Publishing from CI uses npm provenance / trusted publishing; no long-lived tokens
- [ ] Pre-releases published under `next` dist-tag

---

### ST-100

**SBOM, dependency audit and secret scanning**

*As a **security reviewer**, I want **an SBOM and automated supply-chain checks**, so that **enterprises can approve SmartTest**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 2 | S10 | §30.6 | [ST-006](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-006) |

**Status:** changed — Hosted audit and secret-scanning workflows dropped with GitHub Actions. Planned locally in roadmap 0.6.0 (`pnpm audit` + SBOM in `release:pack`).

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] CycloneDX SBOM attached to each release
- [ ] Dependency audit and secret scanning run in CI and block on high severity
- [ ] `SECURITY.md` describes disclosure process

### ST-101

**Documentation verified against the product**

*As a **new user**, I want **docs whose commands actually work**, so that **I can succeed without asking for help**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 5 | S10 | §26, §38.2 | [ST-063](IMP-impact-engine-and-selection.md#st-063), [ST-071](INI-smart-init.md#st-071), [ST-081](GEN-test-architecture-generator.md#st-081) |

**Status:** partial — Docs match the implementation and the command surface is covered by CLI tests; executing doc snippets in CI is not implemented.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Getting-started, CLI reference and configuration reference complete for 1.0
- [ ] Doc code blocks tagged `verify` are executed against fixtures in CI
- [ ] Time-to-first-affected-run under 5 minutes in a usability test with 3 external developers

### ST-102

**Example projects**

*As a **evaluator**, I want **runnable example projects in `examples/`**, so that **I can try SmartTest before touching my repo**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Should | 3 | S6 | §4.2 | [ST-005](FND-core-project-foundation.md#st-005) |

**Status:** partial — The fixture projects double as runnable examples (examples/README.md); dedicated example repos are not split out.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] `examples/node`, `react`, `nestjs`, `monorepo`, `no-vcs` each with a README walkthrough
- [ ] Examples run in CI against the current build
- [ ] Each example demonstrates `run --affected` and `explain`

### ST-103

**Clean removal path**

*As a **developer**, I want **to remove SmartTest without losing any tests**, so that **adoption is reversible**.*

| Priority | Points | Sprint | Spec | Depends on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Must | 2 | S10 | §38.2, §1.4 Non-destructive | [ST-076](INI-smart-init.md#st-076) |

**Status:** done

**Acceptance criteria**

- [x] `smarttest uninstall --dry-run` lists config, scripts and `.smarttest/` to remove
- [x] Generated tests are kept by default (they belong to the user)
- [x] Documented manual removal steps
